'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Greetings, comrade. Come on in, come on in. And lock the door behind you. Gonna have a serious talk... It's time to show everyone whose land we're standing on and who's the boss around here. Because there are already more of these tourists than us - everything that's left in Tarkov has been plundered. They turned Norvink region into some garbage lot. You agree, right? It's not even about the money, it's about driving those fuckers out from our own land! Although I will make it worth your while anyway, as always. Start by clearing the area near the Lighthouse, and then we will throw them out of our other territories. So, are you in?}}

==Requirements==
* This quest is only obtainable by [[BEAR]] PMCs.
* Must be level 30 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
*Eliminate 20 [[USEC]] PMC operatives on [[Lighthouse]]
*Hand over 20 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] [[USEC]] [[Dogtag|PMC dogtags]]

==Rewards==
*+22,000 [[EXP]]
*[[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
*300,000 Roubles
**315,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 1
** 345,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 2
*Unlocks purchase of [[23x75mm Zvezda flashbang round]] at [[Prapor]] LL3
*3× [[TOZ KS-23M 23x75mm pump-action shotgun]]
{{quote|Thank you, warrior. Our homeland won't forget this!}}
